description: This file defines utility functions for handling tensor dimensions, including wrapping negative indices, for the ATen tensor library in PyTorch.

methods.name: maybe_wrap_dim
methods.description: Wraps a dimension index to handle negative indices, for a specific tensor.

methods.name: maybe_wrap_dim
methods.description: Wraps a dimension index for a list of tensors.

methods.name: maybe_wrap_dim
methods.description: Wraps a dimension index based on tensor sizes.

methods.name: maybe_wrap_dims_n
methods.description: Wraps multiple dimension indices in-place, considering scalar tensor special case.

methods.name: maybe_wrap_dims
methods.description: Wraps multiple dimensions in a container, considering scalar tensor special case.

methods.name: legacy_cat_wrap_dim
methods.description: Handles wrapping dimension for concatenation, with special case for size 0 tensors.

methods.name: legacy_cat_wrap_dim_symint
methods.description: Handles wrapping dimension for concatenation with symbolic integers.

methods.name: legacy_cat_wrap_dim
methods.description: Handles wrapping dimension for concatenation over a list of tensors.

methods.name: wrap_all_dims
methods.description: Wraps all dimensions in a vector to handle negative indices.
